summary: Frontend-only smoke of the /upload page redesign (visual refactor with unchanged handlers/testids). All critical presentational + behavioral checks passed for GUEST and ADMIN. No console errors on admin, only expected 401 eligibility calls for guest. No horizontal overflow at 390px or 1920px. All data-testids preserved and functioning: hero title, guest pill, dropzone, choose-file card, url card + input + fetch (correctly disabled when empty), how-it-works toggle, video preview, mark-start (opens MarkerStudio which mounts with data-testid='marker-studio'), all STEP 3 form fields including digits-only jersey enforcement ('10abc9' -> '10'), position/foot/video-type SELECTs with helper-text changing on video-type switch, submit-btn disabled states ('LOCK ONTO YOUR PLAYER FIRST' when file+no marker). Admin login: eligibility-admin pill 'ADMIN · UNLIMITED UPLOADS' shows; guest-upload-pill not rendered. NOTE: Could not exercise the full GUEST -> AccountGateModal path because the 2-second ffmpeg-generated test.mp4 loads in <video> preview but MarkerStudio reports 0:00/0:00 duration (probably container/moov issue with tiny clip), so LOCK stays disabled and we can't complete the mark. This is a test-fixture limitation, not a product bug — the MarkerStudio itself mounts correctly and submit button stays properly disabled ('LOCK ONTO YOUR PLAYER FIRST') as designed. No functional regression detected from the layout rewrite.
action_items: OPTIONAL: For deeper e2e coverage of the AccountGateModal guest-gate path, the marker-studio LOCK button requires a video whose <video>.duration > 0 inside the studio. The 2-second ffmpeg color clip loads but reports 0:00 duration inside MarkerStudio (may be a moov/faststart or metadata read issue in that component). Consider generating fixture with '-movflags +faststart' or using a longer clip for automated end-to-end guest-gate testing.
critical_code_review_comments: UploadPage.jsx is very large (~1450+ lines by problem statement). Consider splitting into <UploadHero/>, <StepOneDropzone/>, <StepTwoPreview/>, <StepThreeForm/> subcomponents post-redesign to improve maintainability.

Guest eligibility check hits an authenticated endpoint returning 401 for guests, producing 10 console error entries per page load. Consider guarding the axios call behind an `if (user)` or handling 401 silently without console.error.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable items (12/12 guest checks, 5/5 admin checks). 1 optional item (guest-gate modal end-to-end) not completed due to test fixture limitation.

test_credentials: admin@elitescout.com / Admin@2026!Elite (verified working). No new accounts created; preview DB left untouched.
seed_data_creation: None. Only generated a local /tmp/test.mp4 (3KB, 2s color clip via imageio-ffmpeg) used for upload input.

Only unverified path: guest submit -> AccountGateModal, blocked by MarkerStudio requiring valid video duration on a locally-generated tiny clip. If retesting this, either use a longer/proper mp4 or mock the marker state to force the gate modal path.
